nom: Philosophy Anti-Wrinkle Miracle Worker+ Line Correcting Eye Cream

avis.texte: This eye cream.takes away the puffiness and dark circles. I love the feal of it and I can see a difference within 5 minutes.

Look, no cream or serum is going to solve all your woes, but this one noticably helps my dark circles while still being hydrating. I've tried literally dozens over many years, if you have dark circles caused by hollows (not puffiness), give this a try!
Thick and rich. Feels good around the eyes. No noticeable difference in fine lines and wrinkles yet. Burns my eyes throughout the day. It's ok.
This stuff is awesome! I've only been using a short time, but my eyes seem brighter….and the feel of this going on is so silky!!!
It's okay. Not my favorite. I think philosophy other eye creams are better
This goes on very nice and does not interfere with my make up.
Been using this eye cream for years and wouldn't start my day without it! Outstanding to minimize swelling under eyes
My favorite eye cream of all time. It has been proving me right since my mid 30s and as I gain on 50, it's still treating me right.
I love this product I use it under the eye firming cream lovely results
Love this eye cream! Softens fine lines and is gentle on this delicate skin area.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel like velvet!!!
avis.texte: I haven't been using this for very long, but i can already see results!! Plus I love the way it makes my eyelids and under eye area feel like velvet!!!
I've been so impressed by all of Philosophy products! They work fabulously!

avis.titre: The best eye creamed I've tried.
avis.texte: Great eye cream, feels so good on and doesn't make your eye smear. I will certainly purchase it again.

avis.titre: I would not purchase this item again.
avis.texte: I did not see any difference after using this product. The price is pretty high.

Philosophy anti wrinkle really works well! It made my skin more soft and even! I had the beginnings of fine lines around my eyes and mouth but after using this you can hardly notice! I will be purchasing more of their products in the future! I highly recommend Philosophy

I'mnot the greatest about implementingnew productsinto my skincare routine so I only used this about 2 weeks and did miss a day here and there. However, I did noticethat it seemed like after the first week my wrinkles were getting better, and continued to improve afterwards.
I had never used this before & while this was not my favorite in terms of a wrinkle reducer, it did provide benefits like glowing skin.

avis.titre: I enjoyed the light weight feel
avis.texte: I rather enjoyed the light weight feel of this moisturizer. Its a great segway into retinols if you are highly sensitive.
My skin felt amazing and I looked and felt better than it has in years. I couldn't believe how well it works. I love it. I have recommended it to several people and will continue to.

I received philosophy anti wrinkle miracle worker + line correcting moisturizer overnight cream free via VoxBox for my honest opinion. Excellent cream. Not greasy at all. Goes great under makeup too. It had helped my face look younger and healthier. Definitely recommend to anyone with seasoned skin!

avis.titre: Excellent eye cream for over 50 years old.
avis.texte: Feels creamy going on. Nice feel as it is applied to your eyes
Product has a great consistency, goes on smoothly without pulling skin. No stinging or burning either! I've only been using it consistently for a couple weeks and I can't wait to see the results!
I have been using this daily for 5 years. Best product I have used for dark circles. Improved 75-80%.
The only product I'll use. Feels great on and dies what it claims.
I keep this all the time; can't be without anti-wrinkle miracle worker! It smooths wrinkles around my eyes, and makeup goes over it beautifully--no pilling!

This product has made my face survive winter. I wake up with a plump moisturized face ready for the day. There are days I don't even feel the need to add serums in the morning because I no longer feel the dry patches i get during the winter season.
This was a gentle and effective moisturizer. I was pleasantly surprised as I do have dry sensitive facial skin. I didn't see any miracles persay, but with continued use hopefully that will change.
If you are a young woman but you're starting to notice aging this is the product for you.it smells great goes on smooth and you can definitely see changes after one week of use

The first day I used this moisturizer my face tingled for a bit. Its texture is thick, but it absorbs quickly. Produc works good as a night moisturizer, but I don't know if it corrects fine lines/wrinkles. Maybe it helps to prevent. Picture I posted was after using the product.
I think it's a great moisturizer, definitely saw improvement. I just wish it had a little scent to it. It made a noticing difference on my skin quality.
I loved this cream. It went on smooth and absorbed quickly. Didn't have a greasy feeling to it. Smelled good too! I would definitely buy it and recomment.

avis.titre: Not heavy, worked well with my other serums
avis.texte: It is unscented, at least I couldn't smell a scent. The texture is very smooth. Not thick or heavy. Not thin. It did work well with my other serums and things. It wasn't greasy either.

I absolutely LOVED this cream!! It provided exceptional hydration during the weeks when our heat was on (and sucking all the moisture from my skin!!) but as our weather warms up now, I've found its also light enough that I don't feel greasy when I wake up either. I'm 42 and don't have a ton of wrinkles but I absolutely noticed that my skin was more even and brighter. Another huge benefit is this cream contains a powerhouse of effective ingredients: peptides, hyaluronic acid, vit C. It's not always easy to find all of these in the same product so really helps streamline your nightly routine! I saw some comments about peeling. I've used a prescription retinoid for many years now and had no issues with peeling with this cream so I wonder if there is some adjusting to the ingredients. Another huge bonus (comparing this to a competitor's night cream) is there is very minimal scent if you're sensitive to scented products. HIGHLY recommend!

I was lucky that Influenster and Philosophy chose me to try this product for free. I have been looking for good night cream for a long time. This product is amazing. Peptides, silk tree extract and hyaluronic acid made my skin look more radiant and reduced fine lines. The cream is not heavily scented, does not irritate my skin. It is gentle yet so effective. The cream is immediately absorbed and does not leave any unwanted residue. Very happy with the results after using it for two+ weeks. I noticed a difference - and so did my friends.
Recharge your skin using the overnite miracle worker. Contains hyaluronicacid to correct your lines and brighten.your skin

avis.titre: Philosophy is one of my favorite brands, and this
avis.texte: As a woman with aging skin, I am always on the lookout for something that may help me look younger. Philosophy's overnight face cream, which contains hyaluronic acid, has honestly made my skin more hydrated as evidenced by reduction in fine lines after using it for a month, before I go to sleep. Also, this did not cause any irritation or breakouts, as many products do due to my sensitive skin. I will definitely be purchasing this! Note: I did receive a sample of this product in exchange for a review. However I will most certainly be purchasing it, as I did notice my skin was no longer flat and dry, and the fine lines in my 41 year old skin definitely decreased after only a couple of weeks of nightly use.

I received this from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This was my first time using a skincare product from Philosophy and I was pleasantly surprised. I noticed an overall improvement in brightness in my skin while using this nightly. I have just about finished the whole jar and would be very likely to repurchase this when it runs out.

The texture is somewhat thick, like a nice whipped lotion. Surprisedly, this product didn't make my skin break out during the couple weeks of usage. Bonus for that! However, I don't think this is suitable for oily skin, which I have, since I've experienced some pillings in spite of all efforts. My recommendation - try if you have dry, and perhaps sensitive, skin. It's a nice product.
My skin is really dry and this really moisturizes my skin You can really see the difference in my wrinkles It soaks right up into my face I use it every night

I received the Philosophy anti-wrinkle miracle worker overnight product for free in exchange for my honest opinion. There are so many great things about this product. First of all it feels divine on your skin. I looked forward to adding it to my bedtime skin care routine. I quickly noticed my skin was looking better. A little extra glow without any makeup, which continued to happen over the past few weeks. I am always skeptical of claims to fix wrinkles and fine lines, but this product delivers. It has been a gradual improvement for me, but I love it so far! You also get a good amount of product!! I was really impressed. Recommend

I recieved the anti-wrinkle miracle worker +line correcting moisturizer overnight cream by Philosophy in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the night cream for the last several weeks and have noticed improvements to my skin. I didn't change anything about my skincare routine other than changing my nightcream. After the first week my skin already appeared more hydrated and I noticed that some of my wrinkles were starting to look less prominent. By the second week my friends and family were able to notice a difference in my skin. My face appeared brighter and more hydrated. After several weeks I have noticed the biggest difference in my forehead lines and wrinkles. The deep lines there were once prominent looked tiny in comparison. I didn't notice any problems with breakouts or my skin drying out, which can sometimes be an issue when I try a new product. My skin took right to the Philosophy night cream. I've tried several brands ranging from low end to high end and can honestly say with confidence this is the best my skin has looked in a while. There was no hint of frangrance, so anyone could use the night cream without having to worry about an unpleasant odor. A little bit of product went a long way, and the cream was not sticky or tacky after applying. I'm truly amazed with the difference in my fine lines and wrinkles. I didn't notice a huge difference in some of the smaller frown lines or wrinkles, but even those looked less noticeable. I can see myself purchasin

avis.titre: Good night cream that can double as a quick mornin
avis.texte: I received this product im a black tub, not upright tube as is shown in my influenster tasks. Product is a little greasy on my skin, but that's ok bc it's a night cream. Can be used as a mask too for a boost of deep moisture and washed off if you want to start your day plump! This does have Vitamin C in it so skip if you have a sensitivity to that. I haven't been using long so I can't say I notice any softening in fine lines but I do notice my makeup goes on better in the mornings if I've used this the night before. So far no adverse reactions.

One of the things I really like is the barely there smell...it's light and refreshing...after about 2 weeks I can def tell my skin feels healthier and looks brighter ...as for wrinkles I haven't seen much of a change but would def purchase again

avis.titre: Wake up to silky smooth skin
avis.texte: I have extremely oily skin, so I needed a moisturizer that would give my skin the hydration I need. This moisturizer glides onto my skin and as I work it in, it almost becomes water-like. There is no greasy residue with this cream or stickiness. When I wake up in my morning, my skin feels nice and plump.

avis.titre: Sinks in and leaves skin feeling great
avis.texte: This cream is luxurious and soaks into skin like a dream. It made my husband's skin feel so nourished and made his fine lines less noticeable. (Sample received for review. I could not use it myself due to citrus allergy.)

Nice clean scent. Lightweight and absorbs quickly. I have sensitive skin and there was no irritation. Nice moisturizing effect and I am happy with the results after 3 weeks. Would definitely recommend.

I received this product to try for a month and really like it. I have normal/combo skin that has a few fine lines that I'm trying to prevent from getting worse. This cream is gentle, I didn't notice any irritation even after using several nights in a row. My skin was hydrated, soft and glowing. I don't think this will give you the same results as a targeted treatment, but it is gentle and effective,

avis.titre: Heavyweight bottle, but Not a Heavy hitter...
avis.texte: I was not happy with this product. When you first apply the cream feels nice and smooth and creamy. Then the product just stays on the surface of your skin. I tried to rub it in more and that causes it to ball up. So for me this product was not a good choice for me. It doesn't have a smell and I like scented things also. The packaging is very heavy though nicely done.
A pretty good product that does what it says....i don't think i've used it long enough to see any real results. I'll try to remember to come back after continued use and give a more detailed review.
Good moisturizer but not as scented as I expected from Philosophy. A little goes a long way. The deep wrinkle near my eyebrow seemed to soften after a couple weeks.

I received Philosophy Anti-Wrinkle Miracle Worker Overnight Cream for my honest review. I've been using this cream for a few weeks now and my skin looks brighter and smoother. This cream has a whipped texture and light scent . In the morning my skin looks hydrated and feels soft. I definitely would add this product to my nighttime routine.

Philosophy anti-wrinkle miracle worker line correcting moisturizer overnight cream works as promised. I appreciate that this cream absorbs in the skin and is not greasy. After a week my fine lines on my forehead were less visible.
My skin is hard to please but the is feels great. It's not oily and does the job. Will definitely continue to use this product.

I have very, very dry skin. This made my face feel amazing! I woke up in the morning and my face was soft and appeared smoother. It did tingle a bit at first from the vitamin c, but that went away quickly. Highly recommend!

I have been using this for about a month . I have lines in my forehead from squinting my eyes a lot and have been putting this on every night.. I have definitely noticed a difference in the lines.. they are less noticeable for sure.. I will continue to use this .. also love that it does not irritate my skin since I have very sensitive skin on my face…

I enjoyed using the product. I have pretty dry skin, especially around this time of the year, and am prone to eczema flare-ups in the winter. The Philosophy moisturizer was very thick, which I loved because it provided me with the hydration needed for my skin type. There is a very light scent that was not at all irritating. I'll be continuing to use this product.

I have been using the Philosophy Anti Wrinkle Miracle night cream for a few weeks now. It soaks into the skin nicely and keeps my skin feeling moisturizer into the morning. Some creams can give me redness and dry patches but I haven't had any reaction to this night cream. My skin looks and feels more moisturized since I've added it to my nightly routine. I'm definitely going to keep using to see the results I get. I received this product for free from Influenster and Philosophy in exchange for my honest review.

I really enjoyed trying the Philosophy Anti-Wrinkle Miracle Worker Night cream! The glass jar is very luxurious. The cream itself has no scent to speak of. I had read some reviews prior to using that people had problems using the cream over serums or other products. I used it alone, as well as over serums and other products and did not have any issues. The key is to use a tiny bit of product and tap it on over whatever serum you're using or product that you're using. The other reviews that I read indicated that people had pilling when the cream was over other products, but when tapped over the other products, instead of rubbing, I did not have any pilling of any sort. The cream is very thick and I have acne prone skin, however, it did not make me break out at all. I did not notice any decrease in wrinkles while using this product but it was an excellent moisturizer. A little goes a long way. This jar will last a long time. I probably will not re-purchase due to the price point and there are other moisturizers out there but this was very nice to use. I thank Influenster and philosophy for allowing me to try this product in exchange, for my honest review.
I've used this brand for years but never this product. I like having a moisturizer and wrinkle fighter in one! It's very moisturizing
Absorbs beautifully with nearly no weight! Soft supple results, such a lovely cream! Plumping and hydrating for dehydrated skin!

avis.titre: Love this 'light as a feather feel' deep moisturiz
avis.texte: I wanted to give this moisturizer a good try before I write a review, as I want to be sure of the results. When I used it the first time, I loved the lightness of the cream, and it absorbed into my skin immediately. Running my hand in the face, I could feel a slight silkiness to my skin with no greasy feel. No strong scents, in fact I could barely smell anything, and after trying for two weeks, a noticeable difference in my fine line under eyes and my forehead. I am almost 52, so I am grateful for a product that does a good job to keep my skin hydrated and reduces my aging. Love this! Definitely will buy again, and recommend it for sure!

This product was sent to me for free from Influenster for my honest review. This product is absolutely amazing and my face has never looked my youthful and beautiful. I highly recommend this product .

avis.titre: Good for very dry skin otherwise its a little too
avis.texte: I feel if you are super dry, this is great. If your skin is anything other than very dry, this might be a little too much. My skin is normal to combo and this felt very heavy and greasy on my skin. It also took a good 10-15 min to fully absorb. My skin did look and feel very hydrated the next morning tho.

I started using the philosophy anti-wrinkle overnight moisturizer couple of months ago and have seen a significant improvement in my skin. It locks in moisture very well. Soothes my skin and is gentle without a strong smell. I usually pair it with my serums. I use a gentle cleanser in the morning and my face is ready for my daily makeup routine.

I've been.using.thr Mircle Worker.creaam for about a mknth now and.have noticed a big.difference.kn.the tone and.texture of ny akin. While i still have wrinkle lines, they dont seem to be as pronounced as they had been before. My skin is left.feeling so soft and radiant.

avis.titre: I didn't see any difference except the pilling on
avis.texte: I was excited to use this product, but after nearly a month, I have only experienced a flare with my rosacea, no change to any wrinkles￼, and I don't know if it is because I use a black silk pillowcase but every morning I would see pilling on my pillowcase that wasn't there prior to using this product. Definitely not something I will be using in the future..

The Philosophy anti-wrinkle miracle worker comes in a sleek black jar in a pleasant compact box. It has a faint pleasant scent that you really have to take a big sniff to smell. The cream is white. It is light weight and feels sheer. I have fine lines and am looking forward to continuing to see the look of my lines being less visible. This is a great product for my night time routine.

This is my first time using philosophy skincare and this face cream is great. I use it everyday and in the morning I feel my skin softer; I used it for several weeks and now my skin looks more brighter and fell it smoother than before. I'll continue using it until finishing it; I can say that this overnight cream works and I definitely recommend it and purchase it when I finish this one. 👍👍

avis.titre: Feels great initially, but leaves a residue build
avis.texte: This miracle worker+ line correcting moisturizing overnight cream is packaged nicely. There is no overwhelming or bothersome scent. The formula is kind of thick, but it applies nicely and doesn't feel heavy on the skin; however, a couple hours after using it, residue would ball up off my skin when I rubbed my face the slightest bit and it also left my skin feeling a little sticky. I thought maybe I had used too much, so went with a much lighter application the next time and it still left like a film of residue on my face. The residue is not visible unless you were to rub the skin and then that's when it will ball up, as if you're able to rub it right off your skin hours after use. Even after sleeping on my pillow, I had some balled up residue on my face. For those reasons, I would not recommend this product. As far as it's effectiveness in reducing fine lines and wrinkles, there was no immediate difference and I was not able to use the product long term because the residue it left behind was bothersome.

This cream makes my skin feel so soft and gorgeous at night I actually use it in the morning sometimes too! The jar is heady and pretty and the texture is smooth and elegant going on. I recommend this for all skin types but especially normal, combo and oily.

This night cream from Philosophy brings smoother, brighter skin when added to your nighttime routine. A beautiful product with a soft, creamy texture. Add this along with visible results on the skin, and a winner is proclaimed. In just a short time I found myself touching my cheeks and thinking how nice my skin was feeling. This is the only new product I had added to my routine. Simply lovely.

This is a very lightweight moisturizer thay delivers great hydration, even in the middle of winter. I did feel like my skin was glowing when I woke up. I used Philosophy products exclusively in my 20s so was excited to find this product at this point in my life. I'm not sure if my skin was just extra sensitive but i did find mila spots after using.

I really wanted to love this thus writing my review close to the end of the campaign. First it is a nice consistency for a night cream- fairly light and non-greasy. The scent? At first I thought it was unscented but there is a small hint of…something? I can't say I liked it. If they left it unscented I would have appreciated that more than my nightly "what is that scent" thought. I used this diligently at night; took some time to figure out the right amount (a pump dispenser might have helped) as too much made me break out and too little left me feeling dry. I can say that I have noticed brighter skin tone, but not evenness. I do not think this has helped any of my fine lines (maybe using this for a longer time period I would see some results). Each morning I woke up and my skin wasn't flakey and felt well moisturized. Overall I think this is a solid night cream, I might purchase again but would love if the company rethought packaging (or included a little spatula) and the scent (it gives me old tea bag plus honey scent flashes).

I've been using the Philosophy anti wrinkle Miracle worker + line correcting moisturizer overnight cream for a few weeks now. I have definitely seen a mild difference in the softening and smoothing of fine lines and wrinkles. Lines on my forehead are somewhat more subtle and wrinkles under my eyes appear more softened. The only thing that I do not like about the cream is that it tends to clump and flake on my skin. I truly believe that continuing to use it, my skin will see more noticeable improvement.

avis.titre: For the softest non-greasy skin imaginable
avis.texte: Philosophy's anti-wrinkle miracle worker overnight does so much to make your face the softest it can be. I love this formula is not scented nor does it leave a sticky greasy residue. I am loving how baby soft my face feels just minutes after applying it. I will definitely buy again and highly recommend.

I was gifted this for my opinion. And I got to say that I really love it. It has a nice smooth cream that moisten my face with a hint of fragrance. I would wake up with a fresh awakening look, and noticed my frown lines were not as long. The only reason why I gave it a 4 is because I started getting a few pimples. But other than that it really worked for me. So yes I would recommend this for combination skin.

This product is amazing! Started using it about 3 months ago, when I bumped up my skin care routine. I'd been using Purity Ultra Light Moisturizer and Purity Eye Gel morning and night (skin around eyes was super dry), for about 2 years, and wanted something richer for winter. OMG, I mixed in the beads, and from the first night I fell in love. In all honesty, I don't see any improvement with my "fine lines", but my skin does feel softer, and when I wake up in the morning, my face doesn't feel dry and tight. It is pricey, but a little goes a long way. Skin does not look or feel greasy when you put it on, so don't worry about messing up your pillowcase.

These creams tend to overpromise and under deliver, but this one is different…in a good way. The cream is thick without feeling suffocating or sticky. It feels luxe and silky like a much more expensive night cream. In fact, I have tried much more expensive creams and haven't been as pleased as I have felt with this one. I focused on my neck and chest area and feel like I saw a noticeable difference in fine lines on my neck area. I only gave four stars because I would have liked a longer timeline to keep experimenting to see if I could notice a larger difference while using the product. Definitely worth an add to what is an already healthy and full night routine!

One word, WOW! I'm so super impressed with this. First off, I love night creams and this one blew me away. I've been using it for 2 weeks now and have seen such an amazing difference in my skin. I wake up in the morning and my skin is so soft and has a glow to it. My skin looks really healthy. I have not seen a difference in my fine lines yet but I have a feeling I will. The scent is not overbearing, in fact there really isn't much of a scent at all. Highly recommend

I love the Philosophy brand and have used their skincare products for years. I was excited to try this moisturizer. Pros: Moisturizes and hydrates well Not at all greasy, sinks into skin immediately No noticeable fragrance Pleasant texture, rich but light cream Packaging in a tub allows every last bit of cream to be used I'm 45 and struggle with occasional acne, red splotches, fine lines, and large pores. This cream didn't do much for my redness issues but seems to have filled in lines well, which is what it promised, and also bonus seems to have minimized my pores. Now if I can get a day moisturizer that reduces redness, I'll be set!

Before using this I thought I had found the best moisturizer however I was sadly mistaken because Philosophy is now my favorite. It feels like what I would imagine a cloud would feel like. It is weightless and doesn't feel greasy on my skin. I noticed a huge difference in my skin immediately after using it nightly.

I used the Philosophy Anti-Wrinkle Miracle Worker +Line Correcting Moisturizer Overnight Cream for a month every night. With the cold weather drying out my skin the moisture that this product gave my skin was amazing. The product is creamy and thick and glides on lovely. As far as the Anti-Wrinkle aspect I really didn't see a difference. I will continue to use the rest of the product for the moisture that it provides.

I really like how rich and creamy this feels going on. It's very luxurious and thick but spreads beautifully. I have had no problems with sensitivity or breakouts with this product. My skin feels deeply hydrated after using this. I do recommend this product. I'm glad Influenster sent me some to check out because I don't know if I would have tried this otherwise and now I'm hooked.

avis.titre: A breath of fresh air for my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have been cycling through five or six different evening moisturizers over the past year, trying in vain to find something that I can use that won't irritate or inflame my skin in conjunction with a retinoid. I've been diligently developing a retinoid routine over the past year. I love the results of retinoids but even a year into consistent use, I still struggle with redness, irritation, and the dreaded flaking. I have been searching for a moisturizer I can use on my "off" retinoid nights that moisturizes and doesn't burn or irritate my face. I have bought several moisturizers that I have specifically read were recommended as "playing nice" with retinoid use. But even the ones that are supposed to soothe or even just not irritate skin, do. A few times I've even gotten what appear to be small chemical burns on my face. My skin is way more sensitive due to the retinoid. This philosophy night cream is the ONLY thing I've used so far that doesn't interact badly with my face. No burning. No redness. Just soothing smoothness and I wake up with soft, moisturized skin. It even helps with the flaking. Just for this fact alone, I will continue using it. I've even been able to layer it over and/or under my retinoid as a buffering product. I also love that this product has really no discernible strong scent. So many of the night creams I've used have a strong, artificial scent. Thank you, Influenster, for the opportunity to try this product! I love it! I received this item for free in

This is the first anti-wrinkle cream that didn't make me break out! I did wake up a bit more oily in the morning, however it didn't make me more oily during the day. After using it as directed everyday for 2 weeks I did gradually see some results. The key is to continue using it and you will see results!

I have been using this every night since I received it. I love it. Definitely noticed a difference in fine lines, and it makes my skin feel really soft without irritation. My skin gets irritated very easily, so I have to be careful when it comes to facial creams and products as I am allergic to allot of products I would think Wouldn't cause allergies. This one has been wonderful. I definitely recommend it especially during the winter months when skin get more dry and itchy. I love the product❤️

avis.titre: Creamy but not a miracle worker
avis.texte: It's a moisturizing product but about 30 min after some of the cream does not absorb and a residue is on my face. I have been using it each night for a few weeks and I don't notice any difference on my skin.

avis.titre: Not good for my acne prone/sensitive skin
avis.texte: I received these products for free from Influenster and brands) in exchange for my honest review. I've always enjoy Philosophy's Purity cleanser, daily Microdermabrasion and body wash. But for some reason, their moisturizer is not good for my acne prone/sensitive skin. It is a bit greasy and leaves my skin very oily. And it starts to break me out, so i have to discontinue using it.

I received this product for free from Influenster and Philosophy in exchange for my honest review. I really like this cream. I have dry skin and my skin looked healthier and more hydrated after just one use. I used it for a few weeks prior to reviewing it. It was very hydrating. I used the cream at night and woke up with a nice healthy glow. Lines around my eyes were softened and my skin was very soft. I would definitely recommend this product and would purchase it.

I received this product free for my honest review from Philosophy and Influenster. I LOVE this Philosophy anti-wrinkle miracle worker overnight cream. It's very rich and moisturizing. I did not have any pilling of product on my skin like some other overnight creams I use. It made my skin so soft in the morning. It has a light fragrance but not overpowering at all. It did not cause my face to break out and overall I have to say that I am very impressed, happy with this product. I would definitely recommend and purchase this overnight face cream. I LOVED it!! I have been using it for almost an entire month an I still have half a jar left so a little goes a long way.

I have been using this product for approximately three weeks. Overall I like the product. It doesn't feel heavy on the skin, there is no scent, and it absorbs completely. It has even out my skin tone. I have dry mature skin, and my forehead gets oily. My skin had been less dry, and my forehead a lot less oily. I've been able to see and feel the difference every morning. I also have used it during the day, and have had the same great results. My only con is that I have experienced pilling with the product. Both on its own, and with use of my regular serums. It's quite odd, as it's not an every time use issue. I will continue to use the product as I like it very much.

avis.titre: This mosturizer leaves your skin glowing the next
avis.texte: I recieved this anti-wrinkke miracle mosturizer by philosophy from influenster for review only. I have to say that this over night mosturizer does exactly what it's suppose to do for dry skin by moisturizing your skin whike you dke5p & the next morning my face was still shiny & mosturized by using this product. Thank you so much influenster for allowing me to test this great skincare. I highly recommend this product.

This unscented cream is like a goodnight hug for my skin! It doesn't leave a greasy feel and it absorbs quickly leaving me pillow ready. I have used it for a week and already my skin looks healthier and brighter. I can't believe it! My makeup goes on smoother in the morning!
I will recommend it to a friend. Makes my skin feels soft. The smell is very nice and very smooth to apply. I have been using it every night, it is a thick formula.
I have been using this on my neck for couple of weeks now. I didn't notice big difference yet. Texture is light but gives you enough moisture.

I received this product from philosophy and Influenster in exchange for my honest feedback. I have used this product every night for two weeks. The component is a black glass jar with white writing. It looks elegant, and it feels heavy. The cream itself is a rich heavy moisturizer. It feels really cooling and moisturizing on my parched winter skin. However, I didn't notice any real added anti aging benefits. I have a lot of texture, redness, and some fine lines and sun damage. I didn't notice any improvement in these issues at all. I also experienced a small breakout, though I'm not sure if that is from the cream or just hormonal. I feel like there are better products available for the price.

I was gifted @philosophy anti-wrinkle miracle worker night cream from @influenster in exchange for my honest review. I can honestly say this product will now be a part of my nighttime routine. The cream has a very high-end feel to it. It absorbs into my skin nicely and just feels so good . I am happy to say my skin, which can look red and uneven, has need less red and looks more even toned. I do feel like the skin around my eyes appear plumper. I enjoy using this product. I love that this product contains peptides, hyaluronic acid and vitamin c, all 3 things I look for in skin care. Love the Philosophy brand.

I absolutely love this nighttime moisturizer by Philosophy. For testing purposes I replaced my nighttime moisturizer and my night serum with this Anti-wrinkle Miracle Worker Night Cream. Not only did it do as well as the two products it replaced… it did better!!! Every morning since using this cream (2 weeks) I have woke up with skin that feels moisturized, soft and smooth. Within a week I noticed fine lines disappearing. I am a grieving mom, our youngest son passed away in 2013. My skin seemed to age overnight and I battle with the ravages of grief as if the pain in my heart somehow reflects in my face. This miracle of a cream has made a huge difference in my appearance. I look younger and my self image has improved. I definitely recommend this and will continue using it as a part of my nighttime regimen!! 🖤

I started using the product immediately..I liked that it didn't have a strong scent and was refreshing. I would recommend this product to others. My only complaint is that it made my skin feel a little greasy if I used too much.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest opinion. First off, I don't really have many wrinkles on my face, so I can't attest to that aspect. I can say that I have sensitive skin with lots of redness (possibly rosacea) and this did not irritate it. The consistency of this product is so soft and smooth going on, almost like a pudding. I didn't use it in conjunction with any other products and it absorbed very well. My skin does appear to be brighter and have a healthier glow about it. My skin also feels smooth after using this. The jar has a very substantial glass feel, which I like better than the plastic ones I've had from other producers. Overall, I have no complaints and will probably repurchase after this jar is empty.

I received this product at no cost from #influencer voxbox I love this product, but it works best at night. It's really rich and thick and a lil definitely goes a long way. I do use it during the day sometimes, but I noticed that my face does become a bit oily after a couple of hours of having it on under my makeup. I would recommend this to people who have mostly dry skin.

I received Philosophy anti wrinkle miracle worker+line correcting moisturizer overnight cream as a sample from Influenster for an honest review. I purposely waited a while to post my review so I could use this product for more than a few days. My skin looks brighter with a more even skin tone. Wrinkles look a little less, not a lot because it's only been a couple weeks. I think there will be a noticeable difference in about a month or so. I recommend trying this moisturizer, it feels good and isn't greasy or cause breakouts. Which is important to me. I'm glad I got this product to review! I will be purchasing more when its gone!
My skin feels and looks softer. The lines feel less deep and the skin as a whole is more hydrated. I would recommend. Not harsh

I received this to try out, I haven't used it long enough to really see any anti-wrinkle results. I am enjoying this and it feels really nice on the skin. It feels hydrating which is nice since my skin gets dry under my eyes in the winter. I have noticed that my skin does seem a little brighter and I've noticed some of my uneven spots look better. I will continue to use this since it's been doing good and hopefully I'll see some improvement in my fine lines and crows feet.

avis.titre: Great moisturizer but not a miracle worker
avis.texte: I have been using this cream for about one month. Here are the pros and cons. Pros: Great overnight hydration No scent Absorbs quickly Softens skin Cons: No improvement in wrinkles or lines Jar lid requires too many turns to open I won't be purchasing this cream in the future at this price. I received this product through Influenster in exchange for my honest review.
This product is amazing! I was given this to review, and I can assure you, I will purchase it again in the future! My skin feels like butter and is so soft! Definitely a must have for me!!!

I have been using this product for about two weeks. It leaves my skin feeling soft and subtle. I don't think I have used it long enough to tell if it will actually help with fine lines and wrinkles. There is virtually no smell. The packaging is easy to use. As a moisturizer I would definitely recommend just can't comment yet on the wrinkle aspects.

The texture of this is really nice. It has a pleasant light scent to it & doesn't aggravate my sensitive, eczema prone skin. I've been using it for a couple weeks now & see some difference in my fine lines & overall skin appearance. I really like this product!

The cream is nicely wiped and absorbs quickly. I would like to say it made a huge difference but you need more than a few weeks to truly judge this. I have scene some change in the fine lines but would definitely like to continue to use it to give a true review.

Te product is a solid moisturizer in ny opinion. I cant tell any line correcting effects, however it feela nice and creamy on the skin while not being too thick. Would I spend this much on a basic moisturizer? Probably not.
Product feels great on my skin! I haven't noticed any real difference with wrinkles, but my skin is hydrated nicely and the cream feels light and fresh on my face.

I mainly have used Clinique products in the past but received this to sample so I figured I would try it. Overall I liked that there was little to no scent and results were as good if not better than the Clinique. This went on easily and was not greasy. It did not cause any skin irritation or breakouts. Not sure if I will make the switch but nice to know there is another product out there if Clinique ever stops selling my favorite cream or even just to occasionally switch things up.

avis.titre: philosophy  Anti wrinkle miracle worker night
avis.texte: Very lightweight non greasy feeling overnight cream. I love the fact it's not heavy feeling & has not bothered my face. Light fragrance which I really enjoyed. I've also worn as a moisturizer during the day a few days. Literally went out of town & forgot moisturizer for my face. This was complementary product & I'll definitely purchase when I need a new jar.

This has a light scent and is not overpowering. Most night lotions and creams can leave my face feeling greasy. This does not which makes me want to keep using it. I haven't seen any wrinkle reduction but hoping with consistent use I will see some improvement.
I received this product from Influenster for my honest review. I like the cream. It is very hydrating and moisturizing.

I have been using this night cream for the past few weeks in place of my usual night cream and it has worked very well at hydrating and softening my skin over night. The jar is sturdy and attractive and the cream is lightweight and easy to apply over my other night time products (toner and serum). There is very little if any fragrance which I appreciate. I have had no irritation and I wake up with softer, brighter skin. I would recommend this cream to anyone looking for a lightweight overnight hydrating moisturizer

This cream was light, but did not soak in well. I put on a very light layer and it seemed to soak in, so I decided to put on another light layer to ensure my face was hydrated well. It didn't feel hydrated enough like other creams I have used. This layer did not soak in and caused beads of skin to roll off my face. My skin also became irritated from the beads. When using this, only use a light layer.

I really like the way this smells. It isn't super strong but nice and sweet. I thought it felt nice when being applied. My skin felt softer and I could definitely tell a difference after using it for even just a few days. I quite a few lines on my face that bother me and I can say they are a lot less noticeable already! I do plan to buy this again when this jar is empty because I love it.

This product was fine. It's not my favorite moisturizer. It is a tiny bit thick which I like during the winter months for my oily skin. It doesn't have a scent. It seems to go on smooth but I noticed it does pill which is unfortunate. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin with this product. I feel there are much better moisturizers to use over this one so I don't recommend it.

It's a great moisturizer for nighttime. It's a little heavy for anything else, but works after a deep cleanse or purifying mask. I also used it on a bit of winter rash and it made a huge difference there as well!
